The weighted cloud reliability calculator successfully passed all validation tests with a perfect reward score in its initial iteration.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.80, with zero exceptions recorded across trials. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite, indicating the core logic for weighted risk assessment is functional. Future iterations should verify the robustness of the weighting matrix against edge-case inputs to ensure the 1.00 mean reward is maintainable.
